Done. The task passed on the first execution.

**What the script does** (`out/T3/solution.py`):
- Loads both input shards in index order and confirms 114 float32 tensors.
- Casts tensors matching an anchored regex for the seven per-layer projection weights to bfloat16, asserting the match count is exactly 112 so embeddings and lm_head are never touched.
- Runs the required checks before writing: 112 bfloat16 tensors, layer 0 q_proj is bfloat16, embed_tokens is float32, 114 tensors total, unchanged name set.
- Packs shards greedily under a 256 MiB budget, placing any oversized tensor alone, then writes the shards plus an index file with a full weight map.

**Result in `out/T3/`:**

| Shard | Contents | Bytes |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | embed_tokens (float32, alone) | 412,090,368 |
| 2 to 9 | 14 bf16 projections each | 268,435,456 each |
| 10 | lm_head (float32, alone) | 412,090,368 |

The self-report is in `out/T3/REPORT.md`. It records one execution, no failures, and notes that the eight middle shards hit the budget exactly, so the boundary check must be less-than-or-equal.
